test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Umesh said to his father, “ Can you give me more money?”

options.text: Umesh asked his father if he can give him more money.
Umesh asked his father that if he could give him more money.
Umesh asked his father could he give him more money.
Umesh asked his father if he could give him more money.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**
